name: dry-well
unmodelled: Cold Toll / Absolute Zero (identity): Ice stacks raise the enemy's drain bills against your hits and ticks; its close halves Ice's art-cost raise
Owed Water: burn and unpaid bills past an empty pool become debt (cap 40 % of the enemy's maximum); their regeneration repays it, half to you
Water Table (enabler): 30 % of the bills the enemy's drain wards pay against your hits restore your linh luc (its close, no regeneration, is modelled)
Frost Tithe: 9 % of the extra art cost your Ice stacks make the enemy pay restores your linh luc
Still Water: linh luc lost to a full pool heals at half
Weighted Bucket (+30 % drain bills against your hits and ticks)
Cracked Clay: L5 +4 per 10 of your Ice stacks on the target, cap +20
Mountain Screen and Thousand-Layer Cloud ward shields (reserved, about 6,110 points at ws 150); only their reservation is modelled
#44 defence: resistance in points, drain rates scaled by ws and we, kept resistance that survives an empty pool
v1 regen_bonus_pct -2 (a regeneration penalty; #44 regeneration is 3.5 % a pulse with no negative bonus, so it is left out)
